text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: \"I do not support driverless cars\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position plainly at the start and keeps that stance visible throughout."},{"evidence":"multiple reasons in separate paragraphs","quality":"organized reasoning","description":"The essay develops its argument through distinct points instead of running them together in one loose stream."},{"evidence":"city access, smart roads, malfunction, personal belongings","quality":"supporting detail development","description":"The essay uses several concrete consequences to explain why it opposes driverless cars."},{"evidence":"\"While driving the car, you would have no control over it\"","quality":"counterargument focus","description":"The essay centers its opposition on a clear concern about loss of control and safety."},{"evidence":"\"The psychological aspects of automation are really a challenge\"","quality":"source integration","description":"The essay brings in a direct quote from the article to support its point."},{"evidence":"longer sentences with linked reasons and examples","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay does more to explain how and why each reason matters rather than just stating opinions."}]}
